title: Valhalla Park (Angela St, approx.): man, 21, found stabbed in water, 20 Oct
summary: Police say the body of a man of 21 was found in Angela Street, Valhalla Park, at about 07:04 on Tuesday 20 October, with stab wounds to his throat (Sergeant Wesley Twigg, via Daily Voice and TygerBurger). He was declared...
story: Police say the body of a man of 21 was found in Angela Street, Valhalla Park, at about 07:04 on Tuesday 20 October, with stab wounds to his throat (Sergeant Wesley Twigg, via Daily Voice and TygerBurger). He was declared dead at the scene. Bishop Lavis police registered a murder case; no arrest has been reported. The reports place the body in water, a vlei (Daily Voice) or a canal (TygerBurger), with tyres over it. No source says when he was killed: the date and time are when the body was found. Police give no motive. A name shared online was not verified by TygerBurger, so the victim is not named here. Two reports, both resting on one police account: Daily Voice and TygerBurger.
incident: Body found Tue 20 Oct 2026 at about 07:04 (police, via Daily Voice and TygerBurger). 07:04 is the discovery time; no source gives when he was killed.
location_note: Angela Street, Valhalla Park (police, via Daily Voice); in a vlei or canal. The spot on the water is not given. The pin is the middle of Angela Street in OpenStreetMap (way 30690124), which OSM labels Nooitgedacht/Elsies River; the street also holds the Valhalla Park Community Centre. It marks the street, not where the body lay.
